title: Modules
summary: Package configuration into reusable modules: root vs child modules, structure conventions, inputs and outputs, sources (local, registry, Git) and versioning, composition patterns, passing providers, for_each on modules, publishing and documenting with terraform-docs.
objectives: Explain root vs child modules and how values flow between them through variables and outputs
Structure a module with main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, versions.tf, README and examples
Consume modules from local paths, the Terraform Registry and Git with pinned versions or refs
Design small, composable modules and avoid over-abstraction
Pass default and aliased provider configurations into modules and use for_each/count on module calls
Refactor existing resources into a module with moved blocks, and document modules with terraform-docs
